title: Blissful Boho Chic Two Bedroom Main Level
description:
Enjoy your own space away from the hustle and bustle of Nashville,  but still close enough to hit all of your favorite places.  This two bedroom two bath is perfect for your family or group of friends.

2 Queen Beds
1 Blow up Mattress (upon request)

Downtown is 25min
East Nashville is 20min
12 South is 23min

LGBTQIA+ friendly.  BLM.  Veteran owned.  This is a safe space for ALL.

*Note: there is another unit on site, so no loud parties are allowed.  IF you need an event look at other listing.

The space
This wonderfully decorated, and recently renovated, house is the perfect place to unwind after a long day exploring Nashville.

Two bedrooms with queen beds.
The master suite has its own private bathroom and shower.

The main bathroom has a full shower/tub.
Fully stocked kitchen.

There is an Airbnb in the far corner of the basement as well.  You get the entire top floor, and backyard to yourself.  The other unit, while in the basement, does not have access to the main house.  It has one exit/entrance which is exterior only.

If you will have more than 6 people in the house at any given time, you must rent via the whole house listing.  If it's unavailable, that means the bottom unit is already rented.

Guest access
This house consists of two floors.  The bottom floor features another airbnb studio suite.  Their entrance and exit are separate from yours.  Only the parking is shared space.

You are free to use the front or back door to enter the house, and you have access to the entire top floor.

If you will have more than 6 people in the house at any given time, you must rent via the whole house listing.  If it's unavailable, that means the bottom unit is already rented.

Other things to note
Absolutely no loud parties.  No smoking inside.  Quiet hours will be from 10pm-7am.

100% of the cleaning fee and pet fee goes to my cleaner.  She is a single mom that cleans for a couple airbnbs.

**If you will have more than 6 people in the house at any given time, or require the space for an event, you must rent via the whole house listing.  If it's unavailable, that means the bottom unit is already rented.**
